admissions.label: Admissions
admissions.description: Count of new patient episode start-of-care events

admissions_by_care_type.label: Admissions by Care Type
admissions_by_care_type.description: Count of new patient admissions grouped by care type

current_census.label: Current Census
current_census.description: Count of active patient episodes as of the reporting date

average_daily_census.label: Average Daily Census
average_daily_census.description: Mean number of active patients per day over the reporting period

current_census_by_service_line_branch.label: Current Census by Service Line and Branch
current_census_by_service_line_branch.description: Active census pivoted across both service line and branch

average_daily_census_by_service_line_bra.label: Average Daily Census by Service Line and Branch
average_daily_census_by_service_line_bra.description: ADC broken down by both service line and branch

daily_census.label: Daily Census
daily_census.description: Active patient count for a specific calendar date
daily_census.where_clause: epi.epi_SocDate <= @AsOfDate AND (epi.epi_DischargeDate IS NULL OR epi.epi_DischargeDate > @AsOfDate)

daily_census_trend.label: Daily Census Trend
daily_census_trend.description: Census count by calendar day across the reporting period — renders trend lines
daily_census_trend.where_clause: epi.epi_SocDate <= cal.calendar_date AND (epi.epi_DischargeDate IS NULL OR epi.epi_DischargeDate > cal.calendar_date)

patient_days.aggregation: SUM(DATEDIFF(day, CASE WHEN epi.epi_SocDate < @StartDate THEN @StartDate ELSE epi.epi_SocDate END, CASE WHEN epi.epi_DischargeDate IS NULL OR epi.epi_DischargeDate > @EndDate THEN DATEADD(day, 1, @EndDate) ELSE epi.epi_DischargeDate END))
patient_days.label: Patient Days
patient_days.description: Total patient-days within the reporting window — sum of each episode's overlap with the reporting period

implied_average_daily_census.aggregation: CAST(SUM(DATEDIFF(day, CASE WHEN epi.epi_SocDate < @StartDate THEN @StartDate ELSE epi.epi_SocDate END, CASE WHEN epi.epi_DischargeDate IS NULL OR epi.epi_DischargeDate > @EndDate THEN DATEADD(day, 1, @EndDate) ELSE epi.epi_DischargeDate END)) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(@ADC_WINDOW_DAYS, 0)
implied_average_daily_census.label: Implied Average Daily Census
implied_average_daily_census.description: Patient days divided by the reporting window — implied ADC based on actual patient-day accumulation rather than a point-in-time count

hospice_census_equivalent_by_branch.aggregation: SUM(DATEDIFF(day, CASE WHEN epi.epi_SocDate < @StartDate THEN @StartDate ELSE epi.epi_SocDate END, CASE WHEN epi.epi_DischargeDate IS NULL OR epi.epi_DischargeDate > @EndDate THEN DATEADD(day, 1, @EndDate) ELSE epi.epi_DischargeDate END))
hospice_census_equivalent_by_branch.label: Hospice Census Equivalent By Branch
hospice_census_equivalent_by_branch.description: Total hospice patient-days by branch — HCE_FACTOR applied for executive rollup

hh_palliative_combined_hce.aggregation: SUM(DATEDIFF(day, CASE WHEN epi.epi_SocDate < @StartDate THEN @StartDate ELSE epi.epi_SocDate END, CASE WHEN epi.epi_DischargeDate IS NULL OR epi.epi_DischargeDate > @EndDate THEN DATEADD(day, 1, @EndDate) ELSE epi.epi_DischargeDate END)) * @HOME_HEALTH_WEIGHT
hh_palliative_combined_hce.label: HH and Palliative Combined HCE
hh_palliative_combined_hce.description: Home Health and Palliative patient-days weighted by HOME_HEALTH_WEIGHT (0.40) for hospice-equivalent normalization

enterprise_total_hce.aggregation: SUM(CASE WHEN epi.epi_slid = 2 THEN DATEDIFF(day, CASE WHEN epi.epi_SocDate < @StartDate THEN @StartDate ELSE epi.epi_SocDate END, CASE WHEN epi.epi_DischargeDate IS NULL OR epi.epi_DischargeDate > @EndDate THEN DATEADD(day,1,@EndDate) ELSE epi.epi_DischargeDate END) * @HOSPICE_WEIGHT ELSE DATEDIFF(day, CASE WHEN epi.epi_SocDate < @StartDate THEN @StartDate ELSE epi.epi_SocDate END, CASE WHEN epi.epi_DischargeDate IS NULL OR epi.epi_DischargeDate > @EndDate THEN DATEADD(day,1,@EndDate) ELSE epi.epi_DischargeDate END) * @HOME_HEALTH_WEIGHT END)
enterprise_total_hce.label: Enterprise Total HCE
enterprise_total_hce.description: Total HCE across all service lines — Hospice at 1.00 weight, Home Health and Palliative at 0.40 weight

avg_days_referral_to_admission.label: Average Days Referral to Admission
avg_days_referral_to_admission.description: Mean elapsed days from referral receipt to start of care
avg_days_referral_to_admission.where_clause: epi.epi_ReferralDate IS NOT NULL AND epi.epi_SocDate IS NOT NULL

admissions_within_2_days.aggregation: COUNT(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(day, epi.epi_ReferralDate, epi.epi_SocDate) <= 2 THEN 1 END)
admissions_within_2_days.label: Admissions Within 2 Days
admissions_within_2_days.description: Count of admissions where start of care occurred within 2 days of referral

billing_holds.label: Billing Holds
billing_holds.description: Count of line items currently in a billing hold status
billing_holds.join: INNER JOIN CLIENT_EPISODES_ALL epi ON li.li_episode_id = epi.epi_id

billing_hold_sla_compliance.aggregation: CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN li.li_hold_days <= 5 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(li.li_id), 0) * 100
billing_hold_sla_compliance.label: Billing Hold SLA Compliance
billing_hold_sla_compliance.description: Percentage of billing holds resolved within the 5-day SLA threshold
billing_hold_sla_compliance.join: INNER JOIN CLIENT_EPISODES_ALL epi ON li.li_episode_id = epi.epi_id

revenue.label: Revenue
revenue.description: Total billed revenue from line items

visit_notes_activity.label: Visit Notes Activity
visit_notes_activity.description: Total visit notes entered within the reporting period
visit_notes_activity.join: INNER JOIN CLIENT_EPISODES_ALL epi ON vn.vn_episode_id = epi.epi_id

visit_note_documentation_compliance.aggregation: CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN vn.vn_completed_flag = 1 AND DATEDIFF(hour, vn.vn_visit_date, vn.vn_signed_datetime) <= 24 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(vn.vn_id), 0) * 100
visit_note_documentation_compliance.label: Visit Note Documentation Compliance
visit_note_documentation_compliance.description: Percentage of visit notes completed and signed within 24 hours of the visit
visit_note_documentation_compliance.join: INNER JOIN CLIENT_EPISODES_ALL epi ON vn.vn_episode_id = epi.epi_id

hospice_census_equivalent.aggregation: SUM(DATEDIFF(day, CASE WHEN epi.epi_SocDate < @StartDate THEN @StartDate ELSE epi.epi_SocDate END, CASE WHEN epi.epi_DischargeDate IS NULL OR epi.epi_DischargeDate > @EndDate THEN DATEADD(day, 1, @EndDate) ELSE epi.epi_DischargeDate END))
hospice_census_equivalent.label: Hospice Census Equivalent
hospice_census_equivalent.description: Total patient days for hospice episodes within the reporting period

total_discharges.label: Total Discharges
total_discharges.description: Total count of patient discharges within the reporting period, inclusive of all discharge classifications
total_discharges.where_clause: epi.epi_DischargeDate IS NOT NULL AND epi.epi_DischargeDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate

discharge_classification_mix.aggregation: CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN epi.epi_DischargeClass = @DischargeClass THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT epi.epi_id), 0) * 100
discharge_classification_mix.label: Discharge Classification Mix
discharge_classification_mix.description: Percentage distribution of discharges by classification category — Death, LiveDC-PatientInitiated, LiveDC-HospiceInitiated, Other
discharge_classification_mix.where_clause: epi.epi_DischargeDate IS NOT NULL AND epi.epi_DischargeDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate

live_discharge_rate.aggregation: CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN epi.epi_DischargeClass IN ('LiveDC-PatientInitiated', 'LiveDC-HospiceInitiated') THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT epi.epi_id), 0) * 100
live_discharge_rate.label: Live Discharge Rate
live_discharge_rate.description: Percentage of discharges that are live discharges (patient-initiated or hospice-initiated) vs. death
live_discharge_rate.where_clause: epi.epi_DischargeDate IS NOT NULL AND epi.epi_DischargeDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate

avg_length_of_stay.aggregation: AVG(CAST(DATEDIFF(day, epi.epi_SocDate, ISNULL(epi.epi_DischargeDate, GETDATE())) AS FLOAT))
avg_length_of_stay.label: Average Length of Stay
avg_length_of_stay.description: Mean episode duration in days from SOC to discharge (or today for active episodes)

median_length_of_stay.aggregation: PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY DATEDIFF(day, epi.epi_SocDate, ISNULL(epi.epi_DischargeDate, GETDATE()))) OVER (PARTITION BY epi.epi_branchcode)
median_length_of_stay.label: Median Length of Stay
median_length_of_stay.description: Median episode duration in days — less sensitive to outlier long-stay patients than average LOS

current_active_length_of_stay.label: Current Active Length of Stay
current_active_length_of_stay.description: Average days since SOC for currently active (undischarged) patients as of the reporting date

lupa_rate.aggregation: CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN pdgm.lupa_indicator IN ('LUPA', 'L') THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(pdgm.period_id), 0) * 100
lupa_rate.label: LUPA Rate
lupa_rate.description: Percentage of PDGM billing periods classified as Low Utilization Payment Adjustments — key financial performance indicator for home health
lupa_rate.join: INNER JOIN CLIENT_EPISODES_ALL epi ON pdgm.episode_id = epi.epi_id

calculated_lupa_exposure.aggregation: SUM(CASE WHEN pdgm.lupa_indicator IN ('LUPA', 'L') THEN pdgm.expected_payment - pdgm.lupa_payment ELSE 0 END)
calculated_lupa_exposure.label: Calculated LUPA Exposure
calculated_lupa_exposure.description: Total dollar difference between expected full PDGM payment and actual LUPA payment — revenue at risk from low-utilization periods
calculated_lupa_exposure.join: INNER JOIN CLIENT_EPISODES_ALL epi ON pdgm.episode_id = epi.epi_id

bp1_compliance_within_48hrs.aggregation: CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN pdgm.bp1_completed_flag = 1 AND DATEDIFF(hour, pdgm.period_start_date, pdgm.bp1_completed_datetime) <= 48 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(pdgm.period_id), 0) * 100
bp1_compliance_within_48hrs.label: BP1 Compliance Within 48 Hours
bp1_compliance_within_48hrs.description: Percentage of PDGM periods where the first billable visit (BP1) was completed within the 48-hour target window
bp1_compliance_within_48hrs.join: INNER JOIN CLIENT_EPISODES_ALL epi ON pdgm.episode_id = epi.epi_id

bp1_compliance_status.aggregation: CASE WHEN (CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN pdgm.bp1_completed_flag = 1 AND DATEDIFF(hour, pdgm.period_start_date, pdgm.bp1_completed_datetime) <= 48 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(pdgm.period_id), 0) * 100) >= 80 THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END
bp1_compliance_status.label: BP1 Compliance Status
bp1_compliance_status.description: Pass/Fail indicator for BP1 compliance against the 80% enterprise target — PASS when compliance rate >= 80%, FAIL otherwise
bp1_compliance_status.join: INNER JOIN CLIENT_EPISODES_ALL epi ON pdgm.episode_id = epi.epi_id
